**MCPay**  
An open-source infrastructure that adds on-chain payments to any MCP server using the x402 'Payment Required' protocol. It enables ChatGPT to make pay-per-call requests automatically and transparently. ([docs.mcpay.tech](https://docs.mcpay.tech/?utm_source=openai))
